entries.title: Psalms 91:1
segments: ¶Happy is he whose resting-place is in the secret of the Lord, and under the shade of the wings of the Most High;

entries.title: Psalms 91:2
segments: Who says of the Lord, He is my safe place and my tower of strength: he is my God, in whom is my hope.

entries.title: Psalms 91:3
segments: He will take you out of the bird-net, and keep you safe from wasting disease.

entries.title: Psalms 91:4
segments: You will be covered by his feathers; under his wings you will be safe: his good faith will be your salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 91:5
segments: You will have no fear of the evil things of the night, or of the arrow in flight by day,

entries.title: Psalms 91:6
segments: Or of the disease which takes men in the dark, or of the destruction which makes waste when the sun is high.

entries.title: Psalms 91:7
segments: You will see a thousand falling by your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.

entries.title: Psalms 91:8
segments: Only with your eyes will you see the reward of the evil-doers.

entries.title: Psalms 91:9
segments: ¶Because you have said, I am in the hands of the Lord, the Most High is my safe resting-place;

entries.title: Psalms 91:10
segments: No evil will come on you, and no disease will come near your tent.

entries.title: Psalms 91:11
segments: For he will give you into the care of his angels to keep you wherever you go.

entries.title: Psalms 91:12
segments: In their hands they will keep you up, so that your foot may not be crushed against a stone.

entries.title: Psalms 91:13
segments: You will put your foot on the lion and the snake; the young lion and the great snake will be crushed under your feet.

entries.title: Psalms 91:14
segments: Because he has given me his love, I will take him out of danger: I will put him in a place of honour, because he has kept my name in his heart.

entries.title: Psalms 91:15
segments: When his cry comes up to me, I will give him an answer: I will be with him in trouble; I will make him free from danger and give him honour.

entries.title: Psalms 91:16
segments: With long life will he be rewarded; and I will let him see my salvation.
